doc: The assault squad (a mixed-range squad: sergeant and breachers) against an unarmed, unkillable rifle dummy 60 m away, on the core package. Variants: attack-move from 60 m, move to the dummy's centre, attack from 60 m, and move to 12 m then hold. Measures dps_engaged (DPS from the first shot) per order: 01's table B (the owner's experience: attack-move and attack stall the shotguns out of range). Gated since sw-txnj.5 (closing to fire): attack-move must reach at least 0.9 of hold at 12 m.

attack.doc: Walks to 25 m from the dummy, then attacks it from turn 3 (an attack needs the target seen at the turn's start, which the assault squad does not get at 44 m; table B's attack column was 44 m).

hold_12.doc: Move to 12 m from the dummy, then hold from turn 3 (the squad centroid at 12 m leaves its rear units out of range; see mixed_range_hold for the table's own placement).

probes.doc: Table B's DPS1 for each order.
Units that fired at all in 30 s (shotguns that never reach range do not).

compare.doc: B3 acceptance: attack-move must reach 0.9 of hold at 12 m.
